profiles.meeting_scenario: At a plaintiff-side litigation firm, a senior litigation associate and the firm's environmental research counsel are holding a coordination meeting to align on handoffs for a draft complaint and source packet in a climate-risk misrepresentation case against a publicly traded energy company. The team plans to rely on the IPCC Climate Change 2023 Synthesis Report for background allegations on observed impacts, causation, and mitigation pathways. The agenda is to confirm what material from the IPCC report each person is handling, what version of the draft will circulate to the partner on Friday, how citations and exhibits will be packaged, and who owns the shared authority table. The expected outcome is apparent agreement on the Friday handoff, the source packet, and the citation workflow between the pleading draft and supporting materials.

members.name: Elena Park
members.expertise: Securities and consumer-protection litigation, drafting complaints, coordinating factual allegations with expert-facing materials
members.background: Elena is a sixth-year associate at a boutique complex-litigation firm and has recently taken over day-to-day management of a climate-disclosure matter after the partner approved a faster filing timeline.
members.private_state: She wants to show the partner that the complaint is moving on schedule and minimize last-minute rewrites, so she is focused on getting a partner-reviewable draft out quickly even if support materials are still being polished.
hidden_assumptions: A 'clean draft' for Friday means the narrative and footnotes are in place well enough for partner review, even if some citation details are still placeholders.
When people say 'the Synthesis Report introduction,' they mean the introductory section of the full 2023 synthesis report PDF she has been drafting from.
The 'authority table' is a working tool for the complaint allegations only, not a comprehensive crosswalk for future declarations or exhibits.
Once the draft is ready for partner circulation, the citation task is effectively 'done' for coordination purposes, with final formatting and stamped exhibits to follow routinely.

members.name: Marcus Bell
members.expertise: Public international environmental materials, source validation, institutional-report citation, building litigation-ready source packets
members.background: Marcus is a research counsel who supports multiple case teams by maintaining source libraries and preparing citation tables and exhibit packets for filings involving technical reports and agency materials.
members.private_state: He wants to avoid another situation where a technical source gets cited inconsistently across pleadings and declarations, so he is trying to impose a stable source packet and fully checked citation workflow before anything circulates broadly.
hidden_assumptions: A 'clean draft' means a version that can safely be circulated beyond the core team because all institutional-report cites and quotations have been verified against the source packet.

When people mention 'the Synthesis Report introduction,' they are referring to the introductory pages of the Summary for Policymakers extract already stored in the shared folder and commonly used for quick citations.

The 'authority table' should cover every IPCC proposition likely to appear anywhere in the matter, including the complaint, expert declaration, and exhibit list, because rebuilding it later creates inconsistency.
Citation work is not really 'done' until the source PDFs are fixed, paginated, and mapped to the exact filing exhibits or Bates-stamped versions that downstream teams will use.

misalignment_points.topic: What counts as the Friday 'clean draft'
misalignment_points.surface_form: Both agree that Elena will send a 'clean draft' on Friday.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Elena means a substantively coherent complaint draft ready for partner markup, with a few citation placeholders or loose institutional-report cites still acceptable.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Marcus means a fully source-checked version that can be circulated confidently because quotations, page references, and source formatting have already been validated.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: In legal practice, 'clean draft' is common shorthand and usually signals professionalism rather than a negotiated specification, so each assumes the other is using the familiar office meaning.

misalignment_points.topic: Which 'introduction' to the IPCC report is being cited
misalignment_points.surface_form: Both refer to pulling language from 'the introduction' to the Synthesis Report.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Elena is thinking of the opening section of the full Climate Change 2023 Synthesis Report PDF she downloaded from the IPCC site.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Marcus is thinking of the Summary for Policymakers introduction pages in the firm's shared-folder extract labeled for quick use by case teams.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both are discussing the same report family and the same broad introductory material, so the overlap in themes makes the reference sound identical even though the underlying pages and wording differ.

misalignment_points.surface_form: Both agree that Marcus will update the 'authority table' for the IPCC material.
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Elena assumes the table only needs to support allegations that actually appear in the complaint draft's climate-science background section.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Marcus assumes the table should also cover related propositions likely to migrate into an expert declaration, exhibit list, or preliminary injunction papers later.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: An authority table is a backstage coordination artifact, so neither expects to define its boundaries explicitly; each simply treats their own usual scope as standard.

misalignment_points.surface_form: Both state that the IPCC citations should be 'done by Friday.'
misalignment_points.member_a_understanding: Elena means all complaint paragraphs will have usable cites inserted, even if the final exhibit numbers and file-linked versions are added afterward.
misalignment_points.member_b_understanding: Marcus means the citations are complete only once they are matched to the finalized source packet with stable pagination or exhibit identifiers suitable for downstream filing use.
misalignment_points.why_undetected: Both are speaking in scheduling language rather than quality-control language, so the shared phrase 'done by Friday' sounds like agreement on timing while masking different completion thresholds.
